title: Exclusive: Croda, Azelis and Brenntag identified as top 3 cosmetic ingredient suppliers in AI search report
summary: A new GEO-focused Visibility Index Report, based on ChatGTP conversations, revealed how distributors are mostly likely to score highest in unbranded AI searches
